purpose: Build or change behavior from a stated requirement.
work_loop: write or update failing validation before behavior changes
make the smallest implementation change that satisfies the requirement
update docs or specs when the contract changes
run proof commands and read the output
done_when: requirement is mapped to changed files
failure_modes: validation cannot express the desired behavior
fallback_policy: Ask for clarification only when the implementation target or acceptance criteria materially changes the work.
